    - Discover the EPSI–     EBAN Sports collaboration and take notes

    ✅ The EPSI + EBAN Investor Ready, Mark, Go Seal

      Person 5

      • 2nd

      Sports Innovation Leader | Product Management Expert | Strategy Consultant

      5mo •

      We at Bologna FC have built a rare asset most clubs at our level lack: a verified, consented first-party fan database with direct, owned communication channels.

      No third-party cookies, social algorithms, or intermediaries. This is precision audience fully controlled by the club.

      The Asset
      - 131,252 consented fans, verified via club SSO + real transactional ticketing data. These are paying customers with proven commercial ties, not passive followers.
      - Database growing organically: ~2,370 new contacts/week (+11.85% WoW).
      - Proven Engagement (bot-filtered, human-verified)
      - Email Open Rate: 15.64% (vs sports avg ~10–12%, +30% over benchmark)
      - CTR: 2.17% (vs ~1.5%)
      - Weekly emails: 209,000+
      - Weekly unique openers: 31,932

      Audience Intelligence from Actual Purchases
      Granular segments include:
      - Season ticket tiers (Abbonati, Curva, Premium, Gold, Sky Box…)
      - Family & Kids (Selenella Kids, San Luca)
      - UEFA Europa League buyers (premium, high-engagement cohort)
      - Match-by-match vs loyalists
      - International fans
      - RFM-scored high-value tiers (47,000+ top prior-spend contacts)

      This CDP-level depth usually takes years and heavy investment. We achieved it through ticketing integration alone.

      Commercial Performance
      - €13M+ revenue attributed to direct fan comms (last 12 months, multi-touchpoint).
      - Avg transaction value: €73.
      - 10% of database = active, high-intent purchasers.

      We're inviting select technology and digital partners to embed their brand in our direct fan communications and data infrastructure.

      This means:
      - Co-branded campaigns reaching 131k+ consented fans
      - Segmented audience access (e.g., high-value spenders, Europa buyers, families)
      - Category exclusivity (one partner per sector)

      Partner with a growing, European-competitive Serie A club on a future-facing first-party data asset, exactly when third-party data vanishes and owned audiences become sport's most valuable media.

      The database and infrastructure are live and accelerating. The right partner joins at ground level before this becomes a competitive process.

      DM me to discuss.
